(the “Company” or “Patrick”) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with LCI Industries (“LCI”), Planet First Merger Sub Inc., a newly formed Delaware corporation and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Patrick (“First Merger Sub”), and Planet Second Merger Sub LLC, a newly formed Indiana limited liability company and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Patrick (“Second Merger Sub”). The Merger Agreement provides for, among other things and subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set forth therein, the merger of First Merger Sub with and into LCI (the “First Merger”), with LCI surviving the First Merger as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Patrick, followed immediately by the merger of LCI with and into Second Merger Sub (the “Second Merger” and, together with the First Merger, the “Merger”), with Second Merger Sub surviving the Second Merger as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Patrick. On November 18, 2026, the Company held a special meeting of shareholders (the “Special Meeting”) at which holders of the Company’s common stock, no par value per share (the “Common Stock”), considered and voted upon (i) the Patrick Share Issuance Proposal, (ii) the Patrick Authorized Stock Increase Proposal, (iii) the Patrick Articles Amendment and Restatement Proposal, and (iv) the Patrick Adjournment Proposal. As of October 15, 2026, the record date for the Special Meeting, there were 32,118,264 shares of Common Stock outstanding and entitled to be voted at the Special Meeting. A total of 29,952,018 shares of Common Stock were present virtually or represented by proxy at the Special Meeting, which constituted a quorum to conduct business at the Special Meeting. Set forth below are the final voting results on the proposals considered and voted upon at the Special Meeting. Each proposal was approved by the requisite shareholder vote.The results of the matters voted upon at the Special Meeting of Shareholders are as follows: Proposal 1 - The Proposal of issuance of shares of Patrick common stock to LCI stockholders pursuant to the Merger Agreement. For Against Abstain 29,054,772 850,299 46,947 Item 8.01 Other Events. On November 18, 2026, the Company and LCI issued a joint press release announcing that they have received the shareholder approvals required to complete the Merger. The Merger remains subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary closing conditions. Subject to the satisfaction of those conditions, the Company currently expects the Merger to close in the first half of 2027. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference herein.
